With Jesus from John's baptism to the ascension (the condition he met)
No verse in Matthew, Mark, Luke or John names him.
Home, trade and family · nothing recorded
Scripture gives no home, trade or family for him
Scripture never names Matthias in the Gospels; Peter's condition implies he had followed Jesus from John's baptism to the ascension (Acts 1:21-22).
Only the condition Peter set (Acts 1:21–22) · 1 record
With Jesus from John's baptism to the ascension (the condition he met)
Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
CHAPTER III · THE CHURCH IN ACTS
And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
He “was numbered with the eleven apostles”.
¶ But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judæa, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
From then on Acts speaks of Peter “standing up with the eleven” and of “the twelve” (Acts 2:14; 6:2), a number that now includes him, but it never names him again.
